description: This script generates an OpenAPI specification file (openapi.json) for the YouTube Course Notes API. It retrieves the schema from an application instance, adds metadata such as contact info, license, and server URLs, and then saves the specification to a JSON file. It also outputs a summary of the API endpoints.

methods.name: generate_openapi_spec()
methods.description: Generates and saves the OpenAPI specification with added metadata, then prints a summary of API endpoints.
